description: Evidence package for D-02 (CN+S), T-01 and D-04 received from the user in the conversation of 2026-11-15. The decisions are recorded as 'confirmed by the astronomers, communicated by the user in this conversation'; the reviewers' names and the date of their review were not provided.
package_notes: The package was flattened; 227 files were received, 109 of them as byte-identical copies with suffixes such as '(1)' whose names did not match their content. Files were identified by SHA-256, the request parameters inside each Horizons file and the comparison rows, not by name.

Archived: the 10 Horizons responses referenced by comparisons.json and the decision evidence. Not archived: the historical prototype report (RAPORT.md, 30 earlier comparisons not re-executed in that run), DEM extracts, other Horizons responses and the IM-1/IM-2 site files of the prototype.
IM-2 and 'scr-study' are prototype positions kept only as historical test references; they are not entries of the active LunarHorizon catalog and are not reintroduced.
